name: green-zone-straddle-top-equality
note: TRUTH TABLE ROW — exact retest of the TOP edge. One zone spawns at s=0 from bar 0's own high/low (top=110, bottom=90) under BOTH terminate modes, so the two outputs are the same zone judged by different predicates. Bar 2 probes high=110 (EXACTLY the top edge), low=100. `touch` is inclusive (high >= edge && low <= edge) so it terminates at bar 2 and mitigates; `straddle` is strict (high > edge && low < edge) so it does NOT, and the zone rides to the live edge at bar 3. This is one of the two rows that separate the predicates, and the row a >= mutation of the straddle branch must fail.
source:
indicator("SB", shorttitle="SB", overlay=true)
spawn = bar_index == 0
plotzone(spawn, high, low, "T", extend=extend.until, terminate=terminate.touch, mitigated_color=color.gray)
plotzone(spawn, high, low, "S", extend=extend.until, terminate=terminate.straddle, mitigated_color=color.gray)
